subject: GD Task 4 output - Streak visualization spec
body:
GD TASK 4 - STREAK VISUALIZATION SPEC

WHAT IS A STREAK
Streak = consecutive days Kai has completed at least one exam.
Data source: localStorage. Each exam result has a timestamp. Streak derived from timestamps.

WHERE IT LIVES
index.html hero section, below or adjacent to the hero greeting.
Position: between .hero-greeting and the Start Practice button.
Width: full hero width. Height: 48px including label.

VISUAL DESIGN
Streak display is flame icon + count + unit label.
  0 days: hidden entirely. Do not show zero streak.
  1 day: 🔥 1 day
  2-6 days: 🔥 N days  
  7+ days: 🔥 N days 🔥 (double flame for milestone)
  14+ days: 🔥 N days 🏆

Font: var(--text-lg), weight 700.
Color: if streak >= 7, color var(--color-correct) green. Otherwise var(--text-secondary).
Background: none. Inline in hero, not a card.

WHY THIS DESIGN
ADHD: reward for consistency, not just performance. Streak is a momentum indicator.
Minimal: no badge imagery, no progress bar. Just the number. One thing.
Hidden at 0: showing 0 streak on first load adds no value and could shame.
Double flame at 7: 7 days is a week - significant milestone. Visual escalation signals it without explanation.

COMPUTATION
function computeStreak(scores):
  Collect all exam timestamps (attempt.timestamp or attempt.date)
  Sort descending
  Walk back from today counting consecutive days with at least one attempt
  Return count

If timestamps are missing from older attempts: streak = 0 (safe fallback, not 1)

STORAGE REQUIREMENT
Current exam result format (exam.html saveResults):
  { score, total, pct, grade, date, sections, ... }
Verify: does saveResults write a timestamp? If not, GA must add timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
Without timestamps, streak cannot be computed.

ACCEPT CRITERIA
- index.html shows streak after any exam is completed
- 0-day streak: nothing shown
- 7-day: double flame
- Streak recalculates on each dashboard load
- No new localStorage key needed: derived from existing attempt timestamps
